items.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23
items.q: The interviewee does not speak in the provided context; the mention of Eddie Johnson is made solely by the Interviewer.

ctx.x: Oh, what's he called him? What do you name him? It was a bell house piano man. No, Eddie Johnson is a sax man. Talking about, you can't call his name either? He's raised up under him, he's older too. Pretty old man, if he was living, he's dead now. Yeah, he's a good feeling. Played all that.

I'll play y'all. I'll play the salted dog first. That dog, I almost forgot how to play. I'll play y'all. I'll play y'all. I'll play y'all. I'll play y'all. I'll play y'all. I'll play y'all. I'll play y'all. I'll play y'all. I'll play y'all.
